minority state ownership has a curvilinear effect on firm value and that this effect is strengthened when a firm is more concentrated in ownership and when the market is more competitive.

minority state ownership (1) is negatively associated with firm value in a curvilineal relationship; (2) is positively related with firm value when corporate ownership ties are weak or strong; and (3) is positively associated with firm value when market competition is high.

minority state ownership (a) negatively influences firm value in the short term but positively in the long term, (b) has the most positive effect on firm value when it is 10% to 15% of the total equity, and (c) has the most negative effect on firm value in the absence of strong corporate ownership ties and high market competition.
